objective: Make the holyagent instructions stop the root from asking what the project's mergeability standard or holyagent's own rules already answer, and from replying to hook and harness noise, and apply the small wording fixes the reviews left.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-instructions (branch ccr-046ad103-6qsvgx-instructions, stacked on the README PR).

User, verbatim: 'não pergunte me (ou qualquer usuário) mais coisas que podem ser respondidas pelo padrão do projeto (mergeability) ou o padrão do holyagent ... tem perguntas que não precisam ser feitas se você já consegue a resposta' and 'não no AGENTS.md, isso é padrão do holyagent'. Rule: before asking, check the target project's conventions, the mergeability dimensions and holyagent's rules (stack plan, version control, CI, asking); when they settle the question, act and record the default instead of asking.

User, verbatim: 'qualquer coisa que o usuário não precisa saber não precisa ser mencionada'. Name the noise the root never writes about: the claude.ai Stop hook ~/.claude/stop-hook-git-check.sh (asks to commit and push on uncommitted, untracked or unverified local commits; keep the checkout clean instead and never reply to it), harness nudges to narrate (one neutral line only when the harness demands visible output after an empty reply, never naming the hook or what it said), tool reminders and deferred-tool lists, holyagent's own hook reminders and session-start status, worker or container restart notices unless something was lost, background-task notification envelopes and workflow diagnostics, GitHub event boilerplate (report only the result), MCP authentication notices the work does not need, and internal ids, revisions, scratchpad paths and CLI errors already resolved. Where: packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements.md first, then packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/asking.md and packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/user-messages.md; replace the weak 'Handle hook and harness feedback silently' line in the core text if it lives in a file you own, else report its location. Work only in your worktree; make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/. Run bun install --frozen-lockfile if node_modules is missing; finish with mise run build and mise run verify and report them.
Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When done and checked, stop and report; no unrequested features or refactors.
